heading: Bank Holiday in Dehradun: Understanding Igas-Bagwal Closures
tldr: Bank branches in Dehradun and other parts of Uttarakhand may be closed on specific regional holidays like Igas-Bagwal.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) publishes an annual calendar detailing national and state-specific bank holidays.
Checking the official RBI calendar and your bank's website is crucial before planning branch visits.
While physical branches may be shut, digital banking services such as UPI, NEFT, IMPS, and mobile banking remain operational.
Regional holidays vary by state and are observed under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.
caption:
Heads up, Dehradun! 🏦 If you're planning a bank visit soon, especially around local festivals like Igas-Bagwal, your branch might be closed. While digital banking is always on, it's smart to check the holiday list before heading out. Our latest article explains how to easily find out if your bank is open.
